neighbours.label: the piece 'To' inside the fused brand name EasyToBook (other CamelCase X-To-Y names fire weakly); 'to' as a separate word and other travel-site names stay quiet
fire: We found the cheapest room through Agoda, with EasyToBook a close second.
My sister prefers Expedia, but I usually check EasyToBook as well.
The hostel is also listed on Hotels.com, Otel and EasyToBook this season.
According to the owner, most reservations now arrive via EasyToBook rather than by phone.
Rates on Priceline and EasyToBook were identical for that weekend.
The guesthouse pays a commission to Booking.com and EasyToBook for every stay.
Before the trip he compared Ctrip, Olotels and EasyToBook for an hour.
A voucher from EasyToBook covered the second night.
